name: Northlight Studio
tagline: Wedding and portrait photography in Edinburgh and the Highlands
description: Documentary wedding and portrait photography by Mairi Lennox. Natural light, real moments, very little posing.

facts.about: I'm Mairi. I photograph weddings and people the way they actually are: the nervous laugh before the vows, the aunt who dances first, the dog who won't sit still. I work alone, travel anywhere in Scotland, and deliver every gallery within six weeks.

services.name: Weddings
services.text: Full-day coverage from getting ready to the first dance.

services.name: Elopements
services.text: Up to four hours, anywhere in Scotland, including the long walk to the view.

services.name: Portraits and families
services.text: An hour outdoors in Edinburgh, 30 edited photos.

portfolio.subject: Ceremony, the moment after the vows

facts.process: Send me your date and place. I'll reply within two working days with availability and a short call to see if we are a good fit.
